prompt: Go runtime MemStats GCCPUFraction excluded CPU activity
answer:
`runtime.MemStats.GCCPUFraction` excludes CPU time used for **write-barrier activity**. The implementation also omits **idle marking time** from overall GC utilization because it is considered “free.”  

Sources: [runtime documentation](https://pkg.go.dev/runtime), [Go runtime change discussion](https://groups.google.com/g/golang-codereviews/c/N_au3ZjrXuA).
